page_title: NIC 2-0 STR | Nice v Strasbourg 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+8' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremy Stinat with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+7' Angelo almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+5' Morgan Sanson (Nice) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+4' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends a rebound goalwards towards the right-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Evann Guessand (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Nice.
90+2' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+1' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcin Bulka, who smothers the ball.
89' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:3.
89' Jeremie Boga (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
88' Evann Guessand (Nice) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
87' The ball is cleared after Angelo (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
86' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Pablo Rosario (Nice) replaces Hicham Boudaoui.
86' A substitution has been made. Gaetan Laborde goes off and Evann Guessand (Nice) comes on.
86' Terem Moffi (Nice) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
85' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
85' 66:34 – the latest ball possession ratio.
84' That's the end of the game for Thomas Delaine, who is replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
84' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Abakar Sylla will be replaced by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
84' A substitution has been made. Ibrahima Sissoko is replaced by Sanjin Prcic (Strasbourg).
83' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
83' A cross into the box from Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is cleared.
82' The game is interrupted now, Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
79' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
79' Strasbourg are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
78' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
77' Francesco Farioli is forced to make a change. Melvin Bard (Nice) is unable to continue due to injury, Romain Perraud comes on.
75' 2 - 0 GOAL! Terem Moffi (Nice) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Matz Sels, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:0.
73' The ball is cleared after Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a throw-in.
71' A cooling break is underway.
70' Terem Moffi (Nice) is caught offside!
69' Francesco Farioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordan Lotomba (Nice) replacing Youcef Atal.
69' Substitution. Jeremie Boga (Nice) in, Sofiane Diop out.
67' A corner kick by Nice is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Strasbourg).

67' The game is pretty dull as Nice are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
67' Terem Moffi (Nice) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
66' Melvin Bard (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
65' Melvin Bard (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
64' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Habib Diarra and he is replaced by Angelo (Strasbourg).
64' Substitution. Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) replaces Jessy Deminguet.
64' The foul by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) was seen by Jeremy Stinat who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
63' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' The game is interrupted as Sofiane Diop (Nice) is flagged offside.
61' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
60' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Morgan Sanson (Nice) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
58' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
57' Youcef Atal (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
56' Youcef Atal (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
55' Terem Moffi (Nice) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul.
54' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
53' A long through ball into the box almost gives Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
52' The ball is cleared after Youcef Atal (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post.
50' Melvin Bard (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
49' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) commits a foul after dangerous play. Nice have a free kick.
48' It seemed like Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
47' Morgan Sanson (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Strasbourg.
46' Terem Moffi (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Thomas Delaine finds Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
45+3' Melvin Bard (Nice) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. It's a throw-in for Strasbourg.
45+2' 1 - 0 Youcef Atal (Nice) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the left post!
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
44' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Shots on target – 3:0.
42' A cross from Melvin Bard (Nice) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
42' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to find Terem Moffi with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
40' Youcef Atal (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
40' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) tries to find Gaetan Laborde, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
38' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Strasbourg will take a throw-in.
38' Ball possession – 72:28.
36' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Matz Sels stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
34' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends a rebound from mid-range to the left post.
34' Sofiane Diop (Nice) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
32' Sofiane Diop (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
31' 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
30' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but Matz Sels comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Morgan Sanson (Nice) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
30' Morgan Sanson (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
29' Terem Moffi (Nice) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
28' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) meets a cross inside the box, but Marcin Bulka wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
25' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

25' What a miss! The corner finds Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
24' There's an opportunity for Morgan Sanson (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

24' The Nice players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.

23' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The ball has crossed the sideline. Strasbourg are taking a throw-in.
22' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
21' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
21' Strasbourg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' The ball is cleared after Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
18' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) is adjudged offside.
16' Youcef Atal (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nice.
15' A pass by Sofiane Diop (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
14' The ball possession is 76:24.
13' Terem Moffi (Nice) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
12' The corner from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is hurriedly cleared.

12' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Hicham Boudaoui (Nice). He steered the ball towards the bar, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.

11' Nice are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nice.
9' Sofiane Diop (Nice) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
8' Terem Moffi (Nice) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
6' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) blazes a shot from a long-range free kick and the ball ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dante (Nice) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
4' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
1' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Strasbourg will kick the game off.
Jeremy Stinat will officiate today.
